0022600167.text: The Rockets (6-1) host the Celtics (5-1) in Houston's eighth game of the season, with Houston 3-0 at home and riding a winning streak of one after a 6-1 last ten, while Boston arrives on a five-game winning streak and a 4-0 home record. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Reed Sheppard is day-to-day with a back issue and is a game-time decision, while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting came on February 4, 2026, in Houston, when the Rockets lost 114-93.
